notes.title: Pre launch build 11/18/2021
notes.content:
Been quite a while since I last updated. Here we go!

 New game, Save , and load fully functional(3 slots)
 All main battles, sides battles and boss battles are fully functional
 Weapons, accessories and support items updated and added
 Leveling system updated
 All achievements added
 Music and SFX updated
 All side quests and collectables added and functional 
 Full controller support(Xbox controller)

Now I will only be making minor adjustments, balances, and any unknown bug fixing. until full release Friday.

notes.title: 5/8/2021 Saturday update
notes.content:
Added a prompt  for what button to press for preemptive strike 
 bug fix- preemptive strike accuracy
 bug fix- enemy can be damaged after player lose 
 When you level up accurate numbers of experience are displayed
 Display of stats now shows when you level up

notes.title: Saturday/Sunday May 1st update
notes.content:
So some issues were fixed and updated, due to a nasty bug I came across that took up most of the time 
What was fixed 

Disappearing mouse issue - Fixed via custom mouse cursor
Controller not letting key board work - Fixed
Really weird reload level issues - Fixed (this took awhile)
 Spacebar can skip enemies in a fight - Fixed (THIS!, this bug took the longest which held up everything else)
Controls - you can now see the controls in the options menu and hints reflect bound controls - which you'll be able to rebind in a future update


Things that where added


 more enemies - specifically in the caves 
 in battle - enemies now have their levels shown
 Hints-  for how to open inventory
 Controls - menu now display controls, will be updated to also be able to bond controls



That's it for now, next update scheduled for next weekend check back during the week on the forums or discord for more details
